responses: Frontend's React with Vite, backend's Python with FastAPI. Intent matching runs on NLTK and spaCy, chat history lives in a database, and anything the intents can't answer goes to Groq's API.
React + FastAPI under the hood. NLTK and spaCy handle pattern matching and word similarity, faster-whisper handles voice, and Groq's models pick up whatever falls outside my intents.
I'm a personal project — a chatbot built to practice NLP and full-stack development, and to be a handy little assistant along the way.
Mainly to help out with quick questions, and to be a real project Itachi could build end-to-end — frontend, backend, and NLP all included.
